_doc: Hand-labelled status spans for items where Phase 5b is expected to split (or NOT split) a single rule-extracted body. Items not listed here are expected to remain a single sub-record matching the rule output. body_start/body_end are offsets within the rule-extracted item's content_text.

expected_spans.note: negative test: body contains the phrase 'not incorporated by reference' near the end (websites disclaimer, body ~14860). Splitter must NOT classify this as IBR — the negation flips the meaning. Whole body is substantive Business disclosure, single extracted span.
